name: prediction-bot-mcp

tools.name: get_daily_scores
tools.description:
Free. Latest daily X (Twitter) sentiment score for each prediction market we track
        (Polymarket), with the change since the previous day, the catalyst and the market's Yes
        price. For a fresh score on any other question use get_market_sentiment.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Free. Machine-readable catalog of every route, price, network and pay-to address.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. Current USDC prices for the paid tools.

tools.name: get_sample
tools.description: Free. Static example of a sentiment response (not live data) to preview the shape.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Free. Service status, prices and the routes available.

tools.name: get_top_markets
tools.description:
Paid (see get_pricing). The three Polymarket/Kalshi markets most discussed on X right
        now, each with a sentiment score (-100..100), catalyst and volume trend.

tools.name: get_sentiment_shift
tools.description:
Paid (see get_pricing). Change in X sentiment for a market question since its previous
        score, with both timestamps and the catalyst.

q.description: A Polymarket or Kalshi market question in plain words, e.g. 'Will the Fed cut rates in October 2026'. Up to 200 characters.
q.title: Q

tools.name: get_market_sentiment
tools.description:
Paid (see get_pricing). Fresh X (Twitter) sentiment for any Polymarket or Kalshi market
        question: score -100..100, the catalyst driving the chatter and the volume trend.

q.description: A Polymarket or Kalshi market question in plain words, e.g. 'Will the Fed cut rates in October 2026'. Up to 200 characters.
q.title: Q

tools.name: get_market_brief
tools.description:
Paid (see get_pricing). Full brief for a market question: score, catalyst, volume trend,
        change since the previous score, a one-line summary and live Polymarket and Kalshi odds.

q.description: A Polymarket or Kalshi market question in plain words, e.g. 'Will the Fed cut rates in October 2026'. Up to 200 characters.
q.title: Q

instructions: Polymarket/Kalshi prediction-market sentiment scored from live X (Twitter) chatter via Grok. Start with get_daily_scores (free: today's scores for the markets we track). Other free tools: get_catalog, get_pricing, get_sample, get_health. Paid tools (get_market_sentiment, get_market_brief, get_sentiment_shift, get_top_markets) settle in USDC on Base via x402 and return a payment quote unless the operator configured a wallet.
